shots.scene: 欣欣站在两台外形相似的设备中间，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two similar-looking lab cabinets and waves at the camera. Blank panels.
shots.narration: 这一课比较两种实验室设备。
overlay: 层流台 VS 生物安全柜：别选错

shots.scene: 欣欣指向左右两个空白设备图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a left and a right blank cabinet icon. No text on them.
shots.narration: 层流台和生物安全柜，别搞混。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在两台机器前，一脸犯难
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of the two cabinets looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰分不清这两台机器。

shots.scene: 阿杰转身问小研，小研指着两台设备
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks a question; the female graduate student points at the two cabinets.
shots.narration: 小研说：它们的目的不一样。

shots.scene: 欣欣出现在两人身旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears beside the two students.
shots.narration: 先弄清它俩差在哪。

shots.section_title: 两种设备：层流台与生物安全柜
shots.scene: 两台空白柜子的剖面轮廓并排
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cabinet cutaway outlines side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 今天比层流台和生物安全柜。

shots.section_title: 层流：平行单向、少湍流的气流
shots.scene: 一组平行、同向的气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A set of parallel arrows all pointing the same direction, evenly spaced. No people.
shots.narration: 层流：平行、单向的气流。

shots.section_title: 层流：平行单向、少湍流的气流
shots.scene: 顺滑的流线，几乎没有漩涡
shots.prompt_en: Smooth straight streamlines with almost no swirls. No people.
shots.narration: 气流很稳，几乎没有乱流。

shots.section_title: 层流的用处：营造洁净环境
shots.scene: 一个闪着洁净光点的工作区图标
shots.prompt_en: A work-area icon with clean sparkle dots. No people.
shots.narration: 它的用处是营造洁净环境。

shots.section_title: 层流首要目标：减少颗粒和微生物
shots.scene: 空气里的尘点被箭头带走
shots.prompt_en: Airborne dust dots being carried away by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 首要目标：减少空气里的颗粒。

shots.section_title: 层流首要目标：减少颗粒和微生物
shots.scene: 一个微生物图标旁边有向下的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon next to a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 把微生物和污染物降下来。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：处理危险生物材料
shots.scene: 一台生物安全柜轮廓，角上有生物危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet outline with a biohazard pictogram in the corner. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜处理危险材料。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：处理危险生物材料
shots.scene: 柜内一个烧瓶贴着生物危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, a flask marked with a biohazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 尤其是有生物危害的材料。

shots.section_title: 安全柜保护操作者和环境
shots.scene: 一个操作者图标和一个环境图标，都被盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: An operator icon and an environment icon, both covered by a shield. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 它保护操作者，也保护环境。

shots.section_title: 安全柜保护操作者和环境
shots.scene: 一个感染微生物图标被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: An infectious-microbe icon blocked by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住感染微生物和毒素。

shots.section_title: 安全柜靠气流、过滤、围护防护
shots.scene: 定向气流箭头、过滤器和围护框三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: directional airflow arrows, a filter, and an enclosure frame. No people.
shots.narration: 靠定向气流加高效过滤。

shots.section_title: 安全柜靠气流、过滤、围护防护
shots.scene: 一个围护外壳把柜子包起来
shots.prompt_en: An enclosure shell wrapping around the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 再加上围护结构挡一挡。

shots.section_title: 目标区别：洁净 VS 围护
shots.scene: 画面一分为二：左边洁净光点，右边围护框
shots.prompt_en: A split frame: clean sparkle dots on the left, an enclosure frame on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 关键区别：洁净还是围护。

shots.section_title: 目标区别：洁净 VS 围护
shots.scene: 左边层流图标标着洁净符号
shots.prompt_en: Left-side laminar-flow icon tagged with a clean symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 层流重在洁净，不管围护。

shots.section_title: 目标区别：洁净 VS 围护
shots.scene: 右边安全柜图标标着围护符号
shots.prompt_en: Right-side cabinet icon tagged with a containment symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜重在围住危险。

shots.scene: 平行箭头水平和垂直吹过工作台
shots.prompt_en: Parallel arrows sweeping horizontally and vertically across a workbench. No people.
shots.narration: 层流的风，平行吹过工作区。

shots.scene: 安全柜前窗处的箭头向内吸
shots.prompt_en: Arrows curving inward at the cabinet front window. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜把风往里吸，护住人。

shots.scene: 两台设备顶部都画着高效过滤器
shots.prompt_en: Both cabinets shown with a HEPA filter block on top. No people.
shots.narration: 两者都用高效过滤器。

shots.scene: 安全柜的过滤器图标上拦住一个微生物
shots.prompt_en: The cabinet's filter icon catching a microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜的过滤还要拦住病原。

shots.scene: 层流台前面是敞开的，没有屏障
shots.prompt_en: A laminar bench with an open front and no barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 层流台没有专门围护。

shots.scene: 安全柜画出前窗、屏障和排风管
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet drawn with a front window, a barrier, and an exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜有前窗、屏障和排风。

shots.scene: 层流一侧出现药片、芯片、培养皿图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the laminar bench appear icons of a pill, a microchip, and a culture dish. No people.
shots.narration: 层流用于制药、电子装配、组织培养。

shots.scene: 安全柜一侧出现毒素瓶、检测和微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the cabinet appear a toxin flask icon, a diagnostic-test icon and a microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜用于毒素、诊断和感染因子。

shots.scene: 两台设备都被一个受控环境框圈住
shots.prompt_en: Both cabinets enclosed by a single controlled-environment frame. No people.
shots.narration: 两者都给受控环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣左右手各指一台设备
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to each cabinet with a different paw.
shots.narration: 但一个重洁净，一个重围护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两台设备中间，各指一台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the two cabinets, pointing to each.
shots.narration: 层流重洁净，安全柜重围护。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger as a reminder.
shots.narration: 都受控，但首要目的不同。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里向镜头挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in the lab.
shots.narration: 分清目的，认准设备，下次见！
